opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips Research Awards

amount.raw: Grants of £500 to £5,000 for research into the human past

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant supporting research into the human past through its material culture or material remains (Britain pre-1800 focus). Part of the Research and Travel Grants programme.

opportunities.title: Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial Awards

amount.raw: Grants of £500 to £5,000 for research into the human past

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Two references required. Awards not made for work contributing to a degree; retrospective applications not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual research award within the Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research into the human past through its material culture or material remains.

opportunities.title: Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales

amount.raw: Grants of £500 to £5,000 for research into the human past

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to a degree; retrospective applications not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual research award within the Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research into the human past, focused on archaeology in Wales.

opportunities.title: Open Research Awards

amount.raw: Grants of £500 to £5,000 for research into the human past

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to a degree; retrospective applications not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual research award within the Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, with no period or geographic restrictions.

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Two references required. Applications from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual research award within the Research and Travel Grants programme, typically supporting archaeological research in the Arabian Peninsula/Middle East (e.g. Oman, UAE).

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Annual Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual research award within the Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research into dress, textiles and costume history.

opportunities.title: Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual travel award within the Research and Travel Grants programme supporting travel for archaeological research and fieldwork.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Memorial Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from the project director or principal investigator. Applicants who require funds primarily for their own research travel should consider applying for a Lambarde Travel Award.
opportunities.summary: Annual travel award within the Research and Travel Grants programme supporting travel for research into the material past.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications require supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the conservation of churches and church furnishings and monuments. Two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March and 31 August every year (applied via Morris form)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications made via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting textile conservation and research. Applications submitted via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.
